abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 199 | 800 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 279 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 188 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 278 | 800 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
